tradingPermission.method: debug_traceTransaction (callTracer) of mainnet router txs: every router entry point calls Authorization.verifyWitnessSignature with permission argument 2
tradingPermission.whyItCannotMoveFunds: Every router action traced (place / cancel / cancel-all and their operator wrappers) checks permission 2 and only reaches OrdersManager / PerpsManager / FeeManager plus one CollateralManager margin-accounting call (0xdf3e62dd) inside order settlement. Withdrawals are CollateralManager.withdraw called directly by the ACCOUNT (msg.sender, tx 0x74d5cc53ae8de64ce2f9c60da2e110f50faad3f428d09757f9bed3fcc3e8ee41), deposits CollateralManager.deposit(address,address,uint256) — neither goes through a signer permit. perp-cli additionally disables 0, 1, 3 and 4. Residual: without verified source a future permission-2 router action that moves funds cannot be ruled out; verify (perp wallet agent verify risex) re-reads the on-chain state.
